title: 'Physical 100: Mexico' Unleashes the Netflix Effect with Records and Unstoppable Trends
summary: Since its premiere on September 16, it has not only shown what the country's athletes are made of, but has also inspired millions of people to share a passion for sports.
body_markdown:
-


The show boosted interest in sports like HYROX (+170%), flooded social media with workout routines, and helped participants gain thousands of followers.


-


Following the success of the first installment, Netflix confirmed a second season; open casting has already surpassed 5,000 registrations.


Since its premiere on September 16,


Physical 100: Mexico


not only showed what the country's athletes are made of, but also inspired millions of people with a passion for sports and the drive to improve, turning each challenge into a collective motivation. Featuring 100 participants from diverse backgrounds and nine high-intensity episodes, the production quickly became a clear example of the Netflix Effect.


In its first week, the show debuted at #4 on the


[Top 10 Global non-English TV list](https://docs.google.com/document/u/0/?authuser=0&usp=docs_web) and remained in the global ranking for two consecutive weeks.


National Pride and Sports Fever


The impact of


Physical 100: Mexico


went beyond views and plays. According to Brandwatch measurements, between September and October, digital conversation focused on discipline, national pride, and the charisma of the athletes.


Contestants like


Jesús Cárcamo


forged a strong connection with the audience, causing searches for him and the show to skyrocket on Google Mexico. At the same time, the slogan “Todo por México” became part of the digital conversation; mentions of it grew by 4% between September and October, peaking on September 20, driven by the reality show’s premiere.


This buzz also translated into real-world physical activity:


-


Google searches for HYROX in Mexico skyrocketed by 30% compared to the previous quarter and by an impressive 170% compared to the same period in 2025.


-


Hundreds of social media posts shared how the show motivated them to return to the gym.


The Faces That Inspired Us


Thanks to their participation, some athletes gained thousands of social media followers between August and October:


-


Ángel Quintero: His follower count rose from 11,537 to 96,648, with a 42% jump between September and October alone.


-


Jesús Cárcamo: He gained 55% more followers on Instagram between September and October, reaching over 206,200 members in his community.


-


El Albañil Legendario: He recorded 108% growth on Instagram, climbing from 234,533 to over 488,200 followers.


-


Mariana Khalil: She increased her following by 83%, surpassing 266,900 followers on Instagram.


> “The reality show was my rebirth: I reinvented myself alongside the best athletes, and that’s where my legacy began,” shared Ángel Quintero, a Mexican endurance and obstacle course athlete.


> “Facing the country’s best athletes, I found my greatest motivation: to prove that willpower knows no bounds,” said Jesús Cárcamo, Captain of the Mexican Army’s Armored Corps.


> “For me, the show was about proving that it doesn’t matter where you come from, but rather the drive, effort, and discipline you put into every challenge,” said Freddy Bautista, “The Legendary Bricklayer.”


From Mexico to the World: Technical Innovation


Habilidad Física 100: Mexico established itself as the largest unscripted series Netflix has ever produced in Latin America, with an unprecedented technical scale:


-


A team of more than 500 local professionals in production, lighting, sound, and color grading.


-


A 5,100-square-meter film set, built to meet production deadlines.


-


The logistical movement of 8 metric tons of sand to set up the strength and endurance circuits.


-


Since there was no existing infrastructure adapted to this extreme format, the technical team designed a custom control booth from scratch, along with unprecedented safety testing protocols and a comprehensive multi-camera coverage model.


It’s time to seek out new talent! Casting is now open for the second season.


On October 16, the production of the second season of Habilidad Física 100: México was officially confirmed. Casting is now open to anyone of legal age who wants to put their strength, agility, and mental endurance to the test. By the end of the first weekend, more than 4,000 people had already registered. To review the rules and register for the official casting call, visit:


[www.100mxcasting.com](http://www.100mxcasting.com/) .
